//dependencies.@supabase/supabase-js: KEEP RANGE-IDENTICAL TO apps/host/package.json. This root entry exists only so the workspace-less repo-root scripts/ and eval/ TypeScript can resolve `@supabase/supabase-js` (npm run type-check:scripts). It is NOT a client dependency -- but npm hoists ONE copy for the whole workspace, so the range written HERE decides which version apps/host BUNDLES INTO THE BROWSER. Declaring ^2.112.2 here floated the hoisted copy 2.108.2 -> 2.112.2, which added +5.4 kB gz of @supabase/auth-js and +2.9 kB gz of @supabase/realtime-js to the shared first-paint chunks and breached the P10 per-page ratchet on /(student)/quiz and /contact (PR #1520). Before bumping either range, bump BOTH together and re-run `npm run build && node scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs`.

scripts.vercel-build: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npm run build -w apps/host && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('apps/host/.next', '.next', {recursive: true})" || exit 0
scripts.lint: npm run check:lint-coverage && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
